name: Cards
summary: Nine meaning cards for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Cards), built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius: Testimonial card, Case study card, Template card, Feature card, Step card, Statistic card, Article card, Integration card and Pricing card, plus a Steps row that lays three Step cards in one horizontal row. Framework-free HTML and CSS, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens. Each type has its own copyable snippet; linked types use one stretched link over the whole card.
highlights: Nine card types on one page, each with its own paste-and-run snippet
Built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius and marketing type scale; not the aha-card web component
Whole card is one link (stretched-link pattern) on Case study, Template, Feature, Article and Integration cards; Testimonial, Statistic and Step cards are static
Hover lift only on linked cards, a visible focus ring around the whole card, and no motion under reduced motion
16:9 template thumbnails, 3:2 case-study and article covers; neutral placeholders until a real image replaces the media block
Grid steps from three columns to two at 991px and to one at 767px; padding tightens at 479px

Pictures fill the media slot edge to edge at their own ratio (aha-marketing-card__media--fill) when a landscape or square image is alone or among others of the same size. A portrait image (taller than wide) is always framed, even alone or when every image is the same size, and so is a section with more than one image of different sizes: they sit uncropped in a Vivid Pink frame (aha-marketing-card__media--pink-frame) with the centre Splash behind them; a grid where readers compare the pictures adds aha-marketing-cards__grid--image-led: two columns at most, every image at least half the content width, one column below 768px

A how-it-works sequence is one horizontal row of three Step cards (aha-marketing-cards__grid--row), each with an optional 3:2 image below the text: three across, one column below 768px, no two-column step
